case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Thank you for your offer and for the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies. We would like to bundle our fastener kit with you as our one distributor, and we are looking for a fair solution for both sides.

Our records show a steady picture:

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

Against this background, we would like to propose a longer partnership. The options below offer different balances of price and payment terms, and a longer contract term gives you planning security:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.12; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

We would be glad to settle this together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We appreciate your proposal to bundle the fastener kit and commit to a 36-month partnership, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. While we confirm the stable price history for two of the components, please note that this historical pricing does not apply to all parts in the requested bundle. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

In response to the extended 36-month contract term while maintaining our standard 30-day payment period, we are pleased to revise our offer to a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
